A has the smoother, cleaner forms and calmer lawn of the real cards; B has heavier wrinkle detail and textured grass blades.
B reads as smooth, softly lit toy-like volumes with a simple buckle collar, closer to the real cards than A's more wrinkled, texture-heavy head and grass.
A is the smoother, simpler build that matches the real cards' finish; B carries more wrinkle and grass texture.
B's body and lawn are smoother and less detailed than A's heavily wrinkled face and textured grass, though B's sparse grass tufts are a small distraction.
A has the smoother surfaces and softer lawn; B adds wrinkle lines and grass texture.
